newsitem.title: USA: Life USA unit gets retail broker approval.
newsitem.headline: Life USA unit gets retail broker approval.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said Tuesday its LifeUSA Securities Inc subsidiary received approval from National Association of Securities Dealers, Inc (NASD) and 48 states to operate as a retail broker dealer.
LifeUSA Securities expects to begin licensing retail brokers in third quarter 1997.

LifeUSA Securities is marketing a family of LifeUSA mutual funds established through a joint-venture agreement with a $16 billion asset management firm and it is exploring distribution of variable life insurance and annuity contracts.
Life USA is a national financial services holding and marketing company based in Minneapolis. Its primary subsidiary is LifeUSA Insurance Co.
